definitions.explanation: A pleasant feeling of coolness or freshness, whether physical (mint, cold drinks) or atmospheric (clean design, cool appearance).

examples.japanese: ミントの{清涼感|せいりょうかん}が{心地|ここち}よい。
examples.english: The refreshing sensation of mint feels pleasant.

examples.japanese: この{歯|は}みがき{粉|こ}は{清涼感|せいりょうかん}がある。
examples.english: This toothpaste has a refreshing, cool sensation.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}と{青|あお}を{基調|きちょう}としたデザインが{清涼感|せいりょうかん}を{演出|えんしゅつ}している。
examples.english: The white-and-blue color scheme creates a feeling of cool freshness.

notes:
USAGE:
{清涼感|せいりょうかん} combines {清涼|せいりょう} (cool, refreshing) and {感|かん} (feeling). It can describe physical sensations (menthol, cold water) or visual/atmospheric impressions (clean design, refreshing appearance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清涼感|せいりょうかん}がある (to have a refreshing quality)
- {清涼感|せいりょうかん}のある{味|あじ} (a refreshingly cool taste)
- {清涼感|せいりょうかん}たっぷり (full of refreshing coolness)

RELATED WORDS:
- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい} (soft drink, refreshing beverage)
